verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms Ramp issues cards (virtual cards with per-vendor limits, cards:write/cards:read_vault API scopes, CLI card activate/creds/lock, a community anecdote about spinning up a 'business expense card' quickly) but nothing in the pack explicitly describes issuing physical debit/credit cards or role-based card assignment to employees. Missing for 10: explicit mention of physical (vs. virtual) card issuance, and documentation of role-based card permissions/limits tied to employee roles.
